executive_summary: Today's intelligence highlights key opportunities in the South African government and mining sectors, with a focus on AI-driven digital transformation and supply chain management. The National Treasury has allocated R 1.3 billion for digital transformation initiatives, and Exxaro Resources expects an 18-23% fall in headline earnings per share, creating potential opportunities for AI consulting services. Kgotla AI must prioritize these sectors to capitalize on emerging trends and tenders.
